core_capabilities: Discover videos through home categories, channels, subscriptions, trending content, and searches filtered or sorted across videos, channels, and playlists.
Watch available videos and automatically add each viewed video to persisted watch history.
Engage with videos by liking or disliking, copying share links, subscribing to channels, posting comments and replies, and reacting to comments.
Organize videos using Watch Later, liked videos, persisted watch history that can be pruned per video or cleared, and user-created public, unlisted, or private playlists.
Upload a video file with a title, description, tags, and visibility and add it to the creator's channel content.
Update an uploaded video's title, description, and visibility and moderate its comments by replying, reacting, hearting, removing, reporting, hiding users, or assigning moderators.
Inspect channel overview and content metrics plus per-video overview and engagement metrics computed from current video data.
secondary_capabilities: Review upload notifications, open their videos, and persistently mark individual or all notifications as read.
Search uploaded creator videos by title or description and sort the resulting content table by date, views, comments, or likes.
